items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: When I was up there with Shoggy.

ctx.x: Well now where we go. I was wondering about when Mares came back from Chicago with the Rhythm Kings.

Yeah. Did he play any jobs around there? Yeah. They uh... I played two jobs. Joe's got the uh... Do you ever go around by Joe's place? Once in a while. Well he's got the ad for this one night. Well I played two nights with him. We played one night at the New Orleans Athletic Club and the other night at the Italian Hall. And it was after that that the band broke up. That's the last two jobs that they played as a band. Before that though they had gone over. They went over to Mobile and they worked over at Mobile…
Who made the records? Do you know?
